# Rule 10 – Erotic and Sexual Content is Forbidden. Due to the server's 16+ policy, minors must be assumed to be present on the server at all times.
Erotic and sexual content is strictly prohibited in all forms and mediums. This includes any erotic roleplay (ERP), sexual roleplay, sexual comments, sexual descriptions, or enactments of sexual acts. This includes text, images, and any other form of content. Violations of this rule may result in an immediate permanent ban.
Basic safe-for-work interactions between characters, such as hugging, are allowed. Romance is allowed, but it should be kept minimal in public and should not become the main focus of the round for you or everyone around you.
Marriages are allowed and may be part of station roleplay. If Character X wants to marry Character Y, it can be done within the bounds of roleplay on the station, as long as it remains safe-for-work and does not become sexual content.
## Clarifications on Acceptable Language In-character insults are not considered erotic or sexual, as long as they do not become excessive or extreme.
Some examples of acceptable insults: - "Fuck you" - insult - "What a motherfucker" - insult - "How about you eat me instead" - Response to an unreasonable request.
It is best to avoid borderline content, ensuring roleplay remains appropriate within the established guidelines.
## Legal Disclaimer In accordance with USA Child Protection and Obscenity Enforcement Act, violations of this law will result in an immediate, permanent ban without possibility of appeal.
